one_line_contribution: A crossed ablation over who supplies the instruction slot (bare / hand-written spec / GEPA / MIPRO) and what is injected (real, content-substituted, order-shuffled, cross-retrieved, skeleton, padded) that claims retrieved agent memory helps almost entirely through a scaffold decomposable into a syntax channel and a procedural-schema channel, so that any instruction stating the scaffold makes memory's gain collapse while its content-borne harm persists.
closest_prior_work: Min et al. (EMNLP 2022) is the acknowledged conceptual ancestor and the proposal correctly argues the agent port is not mechanical (episode-fatal malformed actions, an executable action grammar, the added procedural-schema channel). The more dangerous threat is the two optimizers the proposal uses as instruments: MIPRO/DSPy (Opsahl-Ong et al., 2024) reports instruction-only vs demonstration-bearing ablations and characterizes when optimized instructions substitute for bootstrapped demonstrations, and GEPA (Agrawal et al., 2025) is argued in its own paper partly on the premise that reflectively evolved instructions can match or beat demonstration-heavy prompts. P2/P5 is close to a restatement of that reported behaviour with a retrieval memory bank in the demonstration slot. The proposal never engages either paper's own instruction-vs-demonstration ablations, so a reviewer will ask what E5/P2 shows that S_GEPA's and S_MIPRO's source papers do not already imply. The genuinely unclaimed piece is narrower than the framing: the SCRAMBLE-C / SCRAMBLE-C-SHUF split (E7) giving separate syntax and procedural-schema point estimates on executable trajectories.
strongest_objection: P2, the single pre-registered primary test, is confounded with ceiling compression rather than substitution. S_GEPA + NONE is by construction a much stronger baseline than S0 + NONE, and on a bounded exact-match metric an injection's marginal gain shrinks as the baseline rises for reasons that have nothing to do with who supplies a scaffold. Nothing in the 12-cell E1 grid holds memory-free accuracy fixed while varying whether the instruction states the scaffold, so 'REAL's gain falls from >=5 points at S0 to <=2 points at S_GEPA' is exactly what diminishing returns toward a common asymptote produces. The mixed-effects logistic model mitigates this on the logit scale, but every pre-registered threshold (P2, P5, P6, P9) is stated in raw accuracy points, i.e. on the scale where the confound bites. Two aggravating problems ride on top. (1) The <=2-point criterion in P2, P5 and P6 sits below the design's own paired MDE of ~2.8 points, so a confirmatory prediction is 'confirmed' by a difference the study cannot resolve; the substitution result is then indistinguishable from a 2.7-point surviving gain. (2) The entire confirmatory gain family (P1, P2, P3, P5, P6) is conditioned on gate E0 finding REAL beats NONE by >=4 points at S0, yet the track's own motivating pilot found an injected bank that fixed zero items and broke six to seven. The modal outcome is that E0 fails and the paper degrades to E3/P4, which is a re-analysis of the pilot's already-known harm finding. Separately, the channel decomposition is not arithmetically a decomposition: acc(REAL)-acc(NONE) telescopes as [SHUF-NONE] + [C-SHUF] + [REAL-C], but the proposal substitutes REAL-CROSS for the third term. Since CROSS and SCRAMBLE-C are different injections, the three reported 'shares' use incompatible baselines, need not be non-negative, and can sum to well above or below 100%, which makes P1's '>=60%' and P3's '<=30%' thresholds jointly satisfiable by construction rather than by evidence.
what_would_fix_it: 1) Add an accuracy-matched, scaffold-free instruction level: an instruction tuned on the dev slice to lift memory-free accuracy to S_GEPA + NONE's level using task-content directives only, verified by the E5 clause labelling to contain few syntax/schema clauses. If REAL's gain collapses there too, the effect is ceiling compression and the substitution claim is dead; if it survives there and dies at S_SPEC/S_GEPA, the claim is earned. 2) Make the decomposition additive: define the content channel as acc(REAL)-acc(SCRAMBLE-C) so the three channels telescope to the denominator, and keep REAL-CROSS as a separate relevance estimand rather than as 'the content share'. 3) Set every equivalence bound at or above the MDE (>=3 points), or lower the MDE by increasing n or adding a paired continuous secondary metric; a <=2-point criterion at MDE 2.8 should not be pre-registered. 4) Align gate E0 with P2's own antecedent (>=5 points, not >=4) and pre-register the harm-only null paper as the primary deliverable, since the pilot makes that the likely branch. 5) Run at least three GEPA seeds, or drop causal language about optimizers and rest the mechanism on the deterministic S_SPEC level. 6) Use two annotators for P7 who are not authors; an author annotating their own mechanism story inflates kappa on the one diagnostic that could falsify it. 7) Report HotpotQA and HoVer separately: pooling span-extraction exact match with a 2/3-way claim label under one 'exact match' number gives the two subsets different baselines, different chance floors, and different break/fix semantics, and a shift in the mix alone can move every channel ratio. 8) Run the six named searches before submission. 9) Recheck the compute arithmetic: ~28k episodes x ~8 calls x ~2k generated tokens at ~6k-token prompts is on the order of 10^8-10^9 tokens; the claimed ~13 GPU-hours for the 7B evaluation implies an aggregate throughput several times what 4xA100 delivers at that context length, so the '2 days wall-clock' estimate is optimistic by roughly 5-10x even before the optimizer rollouts.
missing_baseline: Two. (a) The accuracy-matched scaffold-free instruction level described above, without which P2's interaction cannot be attributed to scaffold supply rather than to a higher baseline. (b) An oracle-retrieval / gold-relevant memory arm. The whole content-channel result ('memory's content is worth <=30% and is net-negative') is estimated under one retriever (bge-base, k=4) over a bank distilled by a frontier model from 500 episodes. A reviewer will say the paper measured a weak retriever, not a weak channel, and CROSS does not answer this because it lowers relevance rather than raising it. An upper-bound arm that injects the memory item known to contain the needed fact (constructible from the E9 idiosyncratic stratum) is cheap and is the difference between 'content does not help' and 'this retriever does not surface content that helps'. Also notable, though defensibly cut: the mirror of SCRAMBLE-C (content preserved, syntax/schema destroyed) was removed as SCRAMBLE-F, so the format-vs-content claim is only ever probed from the format-preserving side.
preprint_collision: This is not a thin check, it is an absent one, and by the standard that an unsearched novelty claim is a weakness rather than a neutral it is the second-largest problem in the submission after the P2 confound. The authors report that every search call failed for the second consecutive revision, and state outright that novelty is unverified against the 2025-2026 literature. Candour is worth something, but a submission cannot discharge its literature search with a list of queries it promises to run later; by submission time the claim either has been checked or has not. Confidence in the unverified background knowledge offered as a substitute is further reduced by the disclosed history of a fabricated citation ('ExpRAG, arXiv:2603.18272') in an earlier version, which is precisely the failure mode that unverified recall produces. I cannot name a specific 2025-2026 preprint that already runs this exact crossed format/content decomposition on executable agent trajectories, and I would not invent one, but the space is dense and moving fast: agent-memory ablation papers in the ReasoningBank/AWM line, and the instruction-versus-demonstration ablations inside the MIPRO and GEPA papers themselves, are all live collision candidates, and the proposal's own collision policy concedes that a crossed decomposition on agent trajectories would supersede E1 and force a retreat to E5/E7. Given that the fallback position (the syntax/schema split and the hand-written-instruction substitution test) is also the only part I judge clearly unclaimed, the proposal is effectively asking reviewers to accept its narrower contribution on trust.
